subject: Portfolio Review – Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Mr. Kusuma,

I hope this message finds you well.

I would like to update you on two matters relating to your portfolio held with us. First, our records show that 45.0% of your wealth held within the relationship is concentrated in Indonesian energy exposure, spread across 2 positions and 2 instrument types. Second, your loan-to-value ratio recently reached 78.50%, against the 70% trigger level; this has since moved back within range as a result of movements in collateral prices, without any action having been required on our part.

I would welcome the opportunity to meet with you at your convenience to review these points together and discuss how you would like to proceed.

Please let me know a time that suits you, and I will arrange accordingly.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
